title: Multiply-Add
text: Multiply-add combined operation, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Function} sets function; {Output data type}, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the whether overflows saturate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Specify whether overflows saturate Off (default) | On
